> I wonder the following:
>
> Is it necessary to configure the GLAD model for the 100k Affymetrix
> chip?

Not for practically purposes, that is, you can use the GladModel class
as is, cf. Vignette 'Total copy number analysis (10K, 100K, 500K)':

http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/total-copy-number-analysis

I never had to fine tune the GLAD parameters, but if you wish to do
this, please contact the authors of the GLAD paper/package.

/Henrik
